question: Who won the Best Supporting Actress award at the 97th Academy Awards 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Zoe Saldana**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **The 97th Academy Awards** were held on **March 3, 2025 (EST) / March 4, 2025 (IST)** in **Los Angeles, Hollywood, California**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• **"Anora"** won **Best Film**, dominating with **five major awards**.
 
• **Best Actor** was awarded to **Adrien Brody** for **"The Brutalist"**.
 
• **Best Actress** was won by **Mikey Madison** for **"Anora"**.
 
• **Best Director** went to **Sean Baker** for **"Anora"**.
 
• **Best Supporting Actor** was won by **Kieran Culkin** for **"A Real Pain"**.
 
• **Best Supporting Actress** went to **Zoe Saldana** for **"Emilia Perez"**.
 
• **Best Original Screenplay** was awarded to **Sean Baker** for **"Anora"**.
 
• **Best Adapted Screenplay** went to **"Conclave"**.
 
• **Best Cinematography** was won by **Lol Crawley** for **"The Brutalist"**.
 
• **Best Original Score** was given to **Daniel Bloomberg** for **"The Brutalist"**.
 
• **Best Sound** and **Best Visual Effects** went to **"Dune: Part Two"**.
 
• **Best International Feature Film** was awarded to **"I'm Still Here"**.
 
• **Best Documentary Feature Film** went to **"No Other Land"**, and **Best Documentary Short Film** was **"The Only Girl in the Orchestra"**.
 
• **Best Animated Feature** was **"Flow"**, and **Best Animated Short Film** was **"In The Shadow of The Cypress"**.
 
• **Best Costume Design** and **Best Production Design** were won by **"Wicked"**.
 
• **Best Makeup and Hairstyling** went to **"The Substance"**.
 
• **Best Live Action Short Film** was **"I'm Not a Robot"**.
